C1106.title: Actor Wang Arrested for Filming Fraud Videos for Overseas Scam Syndicate
C1106.summary: In February 2025, Beijing police arrested actor Wang, who is suspected of filming fraudulent short videos for an overseas scam syndicate, receiving 100 yuan per video. Wang impersonated a military veteran in the videos, claiming to participate in a national poverty alleviation project to gain public trust and lure victims into making investments.
